narrative.overview:
A quiet, dense work surface pairs a vendor register with an evidence-bearing case. White panels, pale sage navigation, forest actions, and fine rules keep the monetary outcome prominent without turning every section into a separate dashboard tile.

This record describes the implemented React workspace and its evidence-lab extension, sampled from shared styles, the workbench, case detail, and desktop/mobile review captures. The evidence lab uses local rules to reconcile imported text and invoice credits, with exact source spans beside findings. The guided cases remain prepared demo content. Neither surface establishes live AI analysis or connected services.
keyCharacteristics: Tabular amounts and explicit financial states.
Flat paper surfaces with softly rounded corners.
Named evidence immediately beside the decision.

rules.name: State Has a Name
rules.body: Pair semantic colors with readable labels; a green amount alone does not establish application.

rules.name: Amount First
rules.body: Give the case amount greater visual weight than its status, unit, and supporting evidence.

rules.name: Flat Workspace
rules.body: Keep resting register and case panels unshadowed; preserve overlay shadows for the temporary layer they identify.

dos: Do preserve named state labels alongside semantic colors.
Do keep tabular monetary figures and source references close to decisions.
Do maintain responsive stacking and clearance for fixed controls.
Do preserve visible focus and reduced-motion behavior when extending controls.
donts: Don't treat an issued credit as verified savings without invoice application.
Don't generalize the existing tiny muted metadata into reusable styling.
Don't carry the uppercase workspace eyebrow into new surfaces; it is an incumbent craft-floor defect, not a system primitive.
